headline: AI Demand Fuels Tech Earnings & Confidence
detail: Okta, CrowdStrike, Salesforce, and Nvidia all reported strong results or received bullish analyst upgrades, driven by surging AI demand. This confirms a powerful tailwind for your tech and chip-heavy portfolio.
rec: Your CRWD holding is performing well. Consider adding to CRWD on pullbacks, or look at MSFT (scanner BUY setup: entry 494.66-493.92, stop 489.26) as a new AI-aligned position.

headline: Fed Official Warns of 'Stubborn' Inflation
detail: A Kansas City Fed official stated inflation is "stubborn" and policy rates may not be restrictive enough. This signals potential for higher-for-longer interest rates, which can pressure growth stocks and increase margin costs.
rec: This macro signal suggests caution. Review your overall margin exposure and ensure stops are tight, especially on leveraged positions like SOXL and SPAL, as higher rates amplify drawdowns.
